title: A DEAD LISTENER LEAVES WRECKAGE, NOT A BOX
why: His note: it would be cool if it showed wreckage instead, same for other enemy deaths. A dead Listener left the generic purple cache box. The cache is now tagged a Listener wreck and drawn as the tall machine fallen on its side in its own slate colours, arms sprawled, the dish torn off beside it, smoke while unsearched. Looting is unchanged.
now: A dead Listener leaves a smoking wreck, not a box.

edits.replacement: cl2.time=1.3; G.containers.push(cl2); cl2.bot='listener';   // v28.xx (cw-wrecklistener), HIS NOTE (2026-10-18): "it would be cool if it showed wreckage instead. same for other enemy deaths". The Listener cache is drawn by drawWreckListener, not the purple box
